item.title: Trump plan would scrap IRS basis-shifting reporting rule
item.description: Trump administration proposes scrapping an IRS rule requiring partnerships to report basis-shifting transactions, a tax avoidance tactic once projected to raise $100B.

item.title: Down-payment aid expands to middle-class homebuyers
item.description: Cities and nonprofits are expanding down-payment assistance to middle-class buyers as housing costs surge, with some programs aiding households earning over $200,000.

item.title: Wisconsin PSC orders details on Alliant–Meta data center deal
item.description: Wisconsin regulators ordered Alliant Energy to disclose more details about its contract with Meta for a 220-MW Beaver Dam data center project.

item.title: G7 allies explore critical minerals bloc beyond U.S. plan
item.description: Japan, France and Canada are exploring alternatives to a U.S.-led critical minerals trade bloc as G7 allies seek to reduce dependence on China’s rare earth supply.

item.title: N.Y. Fed survey finds relative calm in inflation expectations ahead of Iran war
item.description: In what’s likely to be the calm before the storm, Americans’ inflation expectations were little changed in February amid mixed views on the state of the job market and current and future finances.

item.title: Iran war fuels central bank rate hike bets on inflation fears
item.description: The Iran war has raised energy costs, prompting European central banks like the ECB and SNB to consider interest rate hikes to combat inflation risks.

item.title: Amid oil shock uncertainty, Fed’s Hammack says central bank must lower inflation
item.description: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland President Beth Hammack said on Friday that while she expects inflation pressures to moderate, if they are not easing later this year the U.S. central bank may have to weigh tighter monetary policy to ensure price pressures retreat to 2%.

item.title: Oil prices surge amid Iran war, Hormuz supply fears
item.description: Oil prices jumped after the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran disrupted supplies and threatened the Strait of Hormuz, sending Brent near $100 and WTI above $95.

item.title: Demolition planned at former Opus HQ site in Minnetonka
item.description: Owner of the former Opus headquarters site in Minnetonka plans to demolish one office building and split the 13-acre property as it prepares the land for sale.

item.title: Edina site ready for redevelopment with Enclave purchase
item.description: Enclave Companies purchased the former Macy’s Furniture site in Edina for $18M, where a 523-unit housing and mixed-use redevelopment is planned.
